common.tagline: A modern CRM for real estate teams

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.description: An overview of your portfolio, current metrics and the daily summary on a single screen.

listings.label: Listings
listings.description: List your entire property portfolio, manage photos and details, publish to portals.

customers.label: Customers
customers.description: Buyer and seller records, requirement matching and customer history are tracked here.

appointments.label: Appointments
appointments.description: Plan your viewing and meeting calendar in daily, weekly and monthly views.

messages.label: Messages
messages.description: Ask your team a question on a customer or listing record, leave a note, or hand over ownership.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Store contracts, title deeds and authorisation papers securely, with version history.

sales.label: Sales
sales.description: Follow sale and rental processes stage by stage, report on closed deals.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.description: View your commission income, collection status and earnings by period.

agents.label: Team
agents.description: Invite team members, manage their permission levels and performance.

reports.label: Reports
reports.description: Detailed analysis of portfolio, sales and team performance lives here.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: System alerts, reminders and team notifications gathered in a single feed.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account, office, billing and integration settings here.

page.description: Manage your profile, notification preferences and account security here.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Adds a second verification step next to your password.
twoFactor.body: Supabase supports two-step verification with an authenticator app (TOTP) — but it is not an on/off switch: it needs QR scanning, code verification and a second step added to the sign-in flow. Enrolling users without asking at sign-in would advertise security that is not there. That is why it was left as separate work.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Choose which events you want to be notified about. Changes are saved instantly.
notifications.hint: For a type you turn off, no notification is created at all — turning it back on later does not bring back missed ones. Your own actions never produce notifications anyway.

appearance.title: Appearance and language
appearance.themeBody: Theme. The app was designed with a single (dark) theme: the design tokens were picked to stay legible on a dark surface, and a light theme needs a second set of all of them. A half-finished light theme would mean broken contrast. The groundwork is there — the light variant in globals.css is waiting.
appearance.languageBody: Language. The interface is available in Turkish and English. You switch it from the globe icon in the top bar; the choice is stored in a cookie and survives sign-out. Translation is now complete: every module except the AI Assistant works in both languages.
